caption:
Up to $1,000 off your tax, and plenty of sole traders never notice it.

The small business income tax offset is 16% of the tax on your net small business income, capped at $1,000 a year. Your business turnover has to be under $5 million. There's no separate form: the ATO works it out from your return and it shows on your notice of assessment. Partners and trust beneficiaries can get it on their share of small business income.

Save this.

General info only, not personal advice.
